answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 4 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the opal count is verified against the voyage text itself, the quartz audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 46 aliases as a result means producing 46 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
